(10 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. Two of them are functional: the rate-key dispatch list no longer accepts the existing `bps=` key, and `limit_*` keys on a `change` command write the reserved rate. Several of the inline points were already raised on the previous revision and still apply to this one.

commit.message:
LU-20099 nrs: set and output the reserved/limit rates

Implement the setting and output of the reserved/limit rates for
the TBF and mClock schedulers.
And it must ensure that the reserved rate should not be greater
than the limit rate when start a classful rule.

Add sanityn/test_77ve to verify it works as expected.

Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=sanityn env=ONLY=77
Change-Id: I6659b9dee8fb7db7392ec4c738e505d86e1c3aec
Signed-off-by: Yingjin Qian <qian@ddn.com>
